about: The Workbench icons of the BStone drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/bstone.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: shaped, shaded, see-through round the edges) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/bstone.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. BStone-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, BStone.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's BStone.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-bstone, COPYING.txt and Licences.txt.
